visualCharacteristics.purpose: Linked image teaser tiles with a theme line and arrow headline
visualCharacteristics.layout: Three tiles at 4 columns each (>= 720), stacked below
notable: Image zooms on hover and may be linked
Arrow icon drawn before the heading link
CTA paragraphs become a button row

contentPattern.structure: one cell per tile: linked picture, theme paragraph, linked heading and text paragraph
contentPattern.rows: 1 row with 1 cell per tile; more rows add tiles

usage: Use for a grid of three image teasers linking to topic pages.
reuseGuidance: Fits image plus short linked headline and text per tile; not for text-only links or more than a few items per row.
